name: band-us-mcp
description: Community BAND.us MCP server on Cloudflare Workers, with secure Streamable HTTP tools for posts, comments, and permissions.

scripts.types:generate: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.wrangler/types', { recursive: true })" && wrangler types .wrangler/types/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareBindings
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
